character.name: 并州游骑 / Bingzhou outrider
character.desc: Mature black moustache and short beard, dark iron helmet, long red scarf, economical brown leather lamellar armor. Mounted on a lean chestnut horse with simple saddle and no barding. Long wooden cavalry spear with small red tassel. Slim mobile frontier cavalry silhouette.
character.special: explosive low galloping breakout, rider leans forward and levels spear

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
